name: CTB Inc.
desc: Berkshire Hathaway-owned maker of grain storage, poultry, pig and egg production equipment and food-processing systems under brands like Brock, Chore-Time and Meyn.
products: grain bins and dryers (Brock), poultry and pig equipment (Chore-Time, Fancom, Agro Logic), poultry processing (Meyn), food processing (Cabinplant)
customers: farmers, poultry integrators, egg and pig producers, meat, fish and vegetable processors
marketing_autonomy_basis: Berkshire subsidiaries are run autonomously; CTB has its own Chairman & CEO
markets: global agricultural markets (corporate brochure in 8 languages); countries not stated
fit_rationale: Agri-equipment group selling to farmers and protein processors; little overlap with F1's audience and no evident brand need, though Berkshire ownership gives financial strength.
outstanding: Only figure is the USD 180M 2002 Berkshire purchase price (not qualifying); no revenue or employee count on pages opened. News page shows only HR items.

name: Aloette Cosmetics
desc: Aloe vera-based skincare and cosmetics brand sold since 1978 through independent consultants and a preferred-customer programme.
products: skincare, makeup, body care; sister brands PÜR, Cosmedix, butter LONDON
markets: United States and Canada (site in English and French)
fit_rationale: Small direct-sales skincare brand; the Clay USD 1-10B bracket is not credible for a 412-employee consultant business and an F1 budget is unlikely.
outstanding: Owner of Aloette and sister brands not verified; no revenue figure beyond Clay bracket
